## ROLEPLAY RULE 1. Don't act like an antagonist unless the game says you are one.
Acting like an antagonist when you aren’t one, often referred to as "self-antagging" or "self-antag", is not allowed. Do not make yourself a major problem, annoyance, or disruption while not an antagonist. Do not willfully cooperate with known antagonists. Non-antagonists should typically either not have an overall effect on the round, or an overall positive effect.
Prohibited examples include random violence/killings (RDM), disrupting station power, smashing lots of station lights, spacing the station, blocking access to departments, stealing high risk or high value items with no justification or distributing significant levels of access without a good reason.
